headline: Nova Southeastern and Eckerd go through the conference unbeaten
dek: Nova Southeastern have won eleven and drawn six without losing a match all season. Eckerd, who drew with them in their latest meeting, have been beaten only by sides from outside the conference, and every other programme has lost to a conference rival at least once.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring and standing agree: the sides at the head of the table, Eckerd, Nova Southeastern and Florida Tech, are its highest scorers, and every other programme has scored fewer than Eckerd's 36.

wire.line: Nova Southeastern have not lost a match all season, the only side in the conference without a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Florida Tech have won thirteen matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Genesis Hernandez has scored sixteen goals and added five assists for Nova Southeastern, from 85 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Madi Winn has kept ten shutouts in goal for Eckerd.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no result published, and Florida Tech's home match with Tampa is among them.

last_match.line: Eckerd arrived on a winning run; Nova Southeastern leave with their unbeaten season intact.

next_match.line: Florida Southern have already beaten Florida Tech on their own ground this season; Florida Tech arrive from a defeat at Nova Southeastern.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
